import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Dataset Visualization', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Survival Rate by Class
survival_by_class = data.groupby('pclass')['survived'].mean()
axes[0, 0].bar(survival_by_class.index, survival_by_class.values, color=['#2ecc71', '#3498db', '#e74c3c'])
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class')
axes[0, 0].set_xticks([1, 2, 3])
axes[0, 0].set_ylim([0, 1])
axes[0, 0].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Survival Count by Sex
survival_sex = pd.crosstab(data['sex'], data['survived'])
survival_sex.plot(kind='bar', stacked=False, ax=axes[0, 1], color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'])
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Sex', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Count', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Survival by Sex')
axes[0, 1].legend(['Did not survive', 'Survived'], loc='upper right')
axes[0, 1].set_xticklabels(axes[0, 1].get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
axes[0, 1].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Age Distribution by Survival Status
data_age = data.dropna(subset=['age'])
survived_ages = data_age[data_age['survived'] == 1]['age']
died_ages = data_age[data_age['survived'] == 0]['age']
axes[1, 0].hist([died_ages, survived_ages], bins=20, label=['Did not survive', 'Survived'], 
                color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Age', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Frequency', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status')
axes[1, 0].legend()
axes[1, 0].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Fare Distribution by Class
data_fare = data.dropna(subset=['fare'])
for pclass in [1, 2, 3]:
    class_fares = data_fare[data_fare['pclass'] == pclass]['fare']
    axes[1, 1].scatter([pclass]*len(class_fares), class_fares, alpha=0.5, s=30)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Fare', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Fare Distribution by Passenger Class')
axes[1, 1].set_xticks([1, 2, 3])
axes[1, 1].grid(alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
